f64_ops.what: IEEE 754 binary64 add and multiply on ulong bit patterns, round-to-nearest-even, subnormals kept

pair_hmm.what: LoglessPairHMM's lattice and last-row sum in software binary64, one read/haplotype pair per thread

f32_ops.what: NVScoreVariants' fused multiply-add (kernels::fused, via the binary64 above) and binary32 addition on uint bit patterns

conv2d_fused.what: NVScoreVariants' convolutions in kernels::conv2d_on_host's order, one output element per thread, in software binary32
